name: Feng Han
title: Assistant Professor
department: Mechanical Engineering, College of Engineering and Computing Sciences; Old Westbury / Long Island campus
fitReason: A useful broader robot-learning lead because the current lab explicitly offers graduate summer research internships. Its strongest methods overlap is data-efficient dynamics and control, rather than foundation-model manipulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: The university-hosted abstract of the 2025 IROS active-data-selection paper reports learned GP control on a three-link robot arm, in fully actuated and underactuated modes. The full paper was not retrieved. A separately inspected December 2023 manuscript verifies real Quanser rotary-pendulum and three-link inverted-pendulum GP control at Rutgers. Current NYIT RAIL lists a LimX TRON 1, small six-DOF arm and mini-Segway, but learned deployment on those current platforms is not independently established.
